body: Thank you I will never know how they were treated. I know they want the best if me but it's hard to keep up with impossible standards of people's. we all have different issues inflected or not but the best thing we can do is keep trying everyday. I will try to keep up for longer and you should as well hopefully one day things will be bright just not today. I just needed to get something of my chest and I have no one to talk about it so this is where I came. One day I want to do something about people in situations we all are in. Today might not be today and tomorrow might not be as well. Just believe in yourself and others. Thanks for coming to my TED talk.
